name: Controlled Distortion (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Nightblade 9, Path of the Twilight Veil

Benefit: The nightblade gains the ability to control the patterns within her distorting shadows. Once per round when determining the random effects of her distorting shadows, she can reroll the random effect that a single creature is affected with. She must do this before applying the effects of distorting shadows to that creature.
